love.name: Love
intro: “But the greatest of these is love” (1 Corinthians 13:13): the text ranking its own terms. And of God himself, “God is love” (1 John 4:8).
Older English translations say “charity” through 1 Corinthians 13 and “love” elsewhere, for the same Greek word, ἀγάπη.

righteousness.name: Righteousness
intro: The Bible mostly speaks of it as something reckoned rather than achieved: ‘Abram believed the LORD, and it was credited to him as righteousness.’ (Gen 15:6), a verse three New Testament writers return to. Whether that reckoning is a change in standing or in the person is among the oldest disputes about these texts, and the verses settle nothing.
righteousness.intro_flag: The card's present introduction, unchanged. Flagged: the rows below count “do righteousness” 48 times and “justice and righteousness” 63, so “mostly reckoned rather than achieved” says more than the text does; for the nine readers.
